hypothesis: Adding skill-efficiency audit signals (conditional-procedure authoring per RMD-SKILLEFF-001) to the maintain-agent-instructions audit criteria lets an auditor following the criteria flag mandatory-ified skill procedures that the baseline criteria miss, without weakening safety-boundary guidance or bloating the skill itself.

metrics.mechanism_coverage: how many of the 5 remedy mechanisms are expressible as audit signals from the criteria doc alone: (1) degrees of freedom matched to task fragility, (2) conditional workflow / applicable-when phrasing instead of unconditional checklists, (3) SKILL.md conciseness as recurring token cost (<500 lines), (4) progressive disclosure / lazy-loaded references, (5) activation scoping (description/paths). baseline expected 1-2/5 (generic length/description signals only), candidate target >=4/5
metrics.fixture_classification: an evaluator applying ONLY the criteria doc classifies 6 fixture skill excerpts; positives must be flaggable by citing a specific criteria line. baseline expected <=1/3 positives flagged, candidate target 3/3 positives and 0/3 false positives on negatives
